title: Review: jmap-client crate — my-oss pass
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — Three P1 issues: wrong error variant (InvalidSession reused), AuthProvider API lock-in on &'static str header name, and undocumented URI template expansion requirement in subscribe_events. All are pre-1.0 fixable. No memory safety issues, no race conditions, no logic bugs found.
Confidence: 10% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: SSE frame detection edge cases for exotic delimiter combinations (covered by tests but complex). Uncertainty driven by: can't exercise full async stream behavior without a real server sending malformed chunks. Would raise confidence if: integration tests with a real JMAP server (Stalwart or Cyrus) or a fuzzer on the SSE frame buffer logic.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — No unsafe, no Box<dyn Error> in API, no unwrap in production code without justification, no index loops, no gratuitous clones. Single non-idiomatic API surface: &'static str for header name in AuthProvider::auth_header (filed JMAP-drv.2). Double-serialization in send_request is a missed optimization (filed JMAP-drv.4). Everything else is idiomatic.
Rust idiom confidence: 8% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: none — the idiomatic issues found are clear-cut. Uncertainty driven by: not running clippy against the actual compiled crate (did static review only).
